assumptions.choice: Fixed size of 100 shares per trade (self.p.trade_size), per the spec's own example value.
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly requires fixed-share sizing and gives 100 as the example; no other number is stated.

assumptions.choice: Trades are recorded in an in-memory list of collections.OrderedDict entries (self.trade_log) rather than an external database.
assumptions.reason: Environment only allows backtrader/math/collections/statistics imports and forbids top-level side effects (no sqlite/file/DB access), so a literal external database is infeasible; an in-process structured log is the closest faithful substitute.

assumptions.choice: Use self.data._name if set, otherwise fall back to the literal string 'AAPL'.
assumptions.reason: The harness's PandasData feed may not have a dataname/_name assigned; the spec fixes the instrument as AAPL so this fallback guarantees the required ticker field is always populated.

assumptions.choice: Log self.boll.mid[0] (the Bollinger Bands' own EMA-based central line) as 'EMA value at the time of the trade' rather than instantiating a second, separate EMA indicator.
assumptions.reason: The spec's EMA(50) is defined as the central line of the Bollinger Bands themselves; reusing boll.mid avoids a redundant duplicate indicator while producing an identical value.

assumptions.choice: After closing a position on a signal, no new opposite-direction position is opened on that same bar; a new entry can only occur on a later bar.
assumptions.reason: Canonical default: hold at most one position at a time, no pyramiding/re-entry while a position is open; spec does not state simultaneous reversal-on-close behavior.

assumptions.choice: No code added for initial capital; rely on the harness-configured starting cash of $10,000.
assumptions.reason: Cerebro/broker setup (including starting cash) is added by the harness per the environment description, so the strategy class itself has no mechanism or need to set it.
